examples.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: an ORIGINAL scientific figure style example for a desktop style selector. Output landscape 3:2, white background, crisp publication-quality lettering, lots of readable whitespace, no title, no watermark, no surrounding UI. All five exact labels in large legible English: Dataset, Encoder, Prediction, Loss, Update. Scientific content is an illustrative training loop only, not experimental results. Exactly the directed relationships Dataset -> Encoder -> Prediction -> Loss -> Update and a dashed feedback arrow Update -> Encoder. Never reverse any arrow, add scientific labels, fake numerical measurements, chart axes or equations. Main forward stages left-to-right, Update below Encoder and Loss, with clear arrow routing. Draw meaningful visual forms specified below; the styles must differ in geometry and representation, not merely color. Palette restrained indigo, teal, warm amber and neutral charcoal with high contrast labels.
STYLE: technical schematic. Flat vector scientific diagram. Data represented by a neat small sheet stack, computational Encoder as a rectangular block with sharply defined input/output ports, Prediction as a short three-token strip, Loss as a comparison diamond, Update as a small rounded operation block. Thin uniform dark outlines, flat restrained fill, rectilinear elbow arrows with visible arrowheads. Exact labels below each form or centered legibly. Strict grid alignment and ample whitespace; no decorative icons or shadows.
